proposal_title_zh: 京张城市操作系统：把百年AI创新带做成可开源迭代的城市智能体
proposal_title_en: Jing-Zhang CityOS: An Open-Source, Version-Controlled Urban Intelligence Platform
core_concept: City Operating System (CityOS) — treating the innovation belt as a version-controlled, open-source, contribution-traceable urban intelligence platform
differentiation: Unlike spatial-structure-first approaches, CityOS positions the belt as a living platform with six-layer tech stack, CRUD-based urban renewal, Git-style version control, and open-source contribution model
